title: Support Measures for Phase Two (Heightened Alert)
what_it_is: Support Measures for Phase Two (Heightened Alert)

sections.label: Jobs Support Scheme enhancements extended
sections.summary: JSS enhancements for affected sectors are increased and extended four weeks to 18 August, with 60% support for sectors required to close.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The additional support measures I announced last week have taken this feedback into account, so, let me provide a quick summary.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We will continue to help enterprises retain their local workers by increasing and extending the Jobs Support Scheme (JSS) enhancements for affected sectors by four weeks until 18 August.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: For sectors that are required to close or suspend most of their activities, we are providing 60% JSS support, up from 50% previously.

sections.label: Landlords required to give rental support
sections.summary: The Government intends to require landlords to provide a matching two-week rental support to tenants, after landlords were not forthcoming.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: However, many tenants, especially those in the affected F&B and retail sectors, have told us that not all landlords were forthcoming in providing such rental support.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: This time, in light of the difficulties faced by many businesses, the Government intends to require landlords to provide a matching two-week rental support to their tenants.

sections.label: COVID-19 Recovery Grant income-loss extension
sections.summary: The COVID-19 Recovery Grant Temporary scheme's income-loss coverage is extended to end-August, with eligible workers able to re-apply for a second payout.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: In particular, to ensure continued assistance to individuals impacted by the safe management measures, we have extended the COVID-19 Recovery Grant – Temporary scheme’s income-loss coverage period from end-July to end-August.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Eligible workers who continue to be impacted can re-apply to receive a second payout.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: This latest round of support measures for the current Phase Two (Heightened Alert) is expected to cost $1.1 billion.

sections.label: FY2021 fiscal position unchanged
sections.summary: Because the support package is funded via reallocation, the overall FY2021 fiscal position is expected to remain unchanged with an $11 billion deficit.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Given that we are funding this support package via reallocation, we expect the overall fiscal position for FY2021 to remain unchanged with an overall deficit of $11 billion or 2.2% of gross domestic product (GDP).
